prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV01 atmosphere overlay for an original hand-painted mobile game, full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas.
Primary request: A very sparse delicate scattering of tiny warm golden dust and pollen flecks in a sunlit harbor. Three or four very faint short warm translucent sunlight streaks only near the upper-left corner. Most of the canvas remains truly empty and transparent. This is an independent subtle particle layer for parallax animation above a gouache scene.
Style: painterly small gouache speckles with feather-soft alpha edges, gentle warm cream light. No photographic bokeh circles. Flecks vary slightly in size, but almost all are smaller than five pixels at this canvas scale. Use fewer than thirty faint motes, spaced broadly apart.
Composition: Sparse flecks on outer areas; central action region has almost no visible particles. All particles are dim and subtle and do not obscure small actors or objects. Full 1536 by 1024 canvas with genuine transparent alpha.
Constraints: NO scenery, NO sky wash, NO ground, NO water, NO buildings, NO character, NO winged insect, NO star, NO sparkle icon, NO rays across the whole canvas, NO cloud, NO fog, NO smoke, NO steam, NO opaque color background, NO lettering, NO UI, NO watermark. Only a few subtle light motes and faint corner sunlight on transparency.
